# Data and descriptive Statistics

importamos la bd

```{r}
#install.packages("pder")
library(pder)
data("Mafia")
```

Limpiamos la bd

```{r}
# Cargar librerías
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# Cargar shapefile de Italia
italy <- st_read("it_shp/it.shp", quiet = TRUE)

# Tabla de equivalencias entre nombres del shapefile y del dataset Mafia
equivalencias <- data.frame(
  shp_name   = c("Turin", "Aoste", "Mantova", "Bozen", "Padova",
                 "Reggio Emilia", "Forlì-Cesena", "Massa-Carrara",
                 "Firenze", "Pesaro e Urbino", "Reggio Calabria",
                 "Siracusa", "Oristrano"),
  mafia_name = c("Torino", "Aosta", "Mantua", "Bolzano", "Padua",
                 "Reggio Nell'Emilia", "Forli' - Cesena", "Massa Carrara",
                 "Florence", "Pesaro E Urbino", "Reggio Di Calabria",
                 "Syracuse", "Oristano")
)

# Filtrar y renombrar provincias para que coincidan con Mafia
italy_clean <- italy |>
  left_join(equivalencias, by = c("name" = "shp_name")) |>
  mutate(province = ifelse(is.na(mafia_name), name, mafia_name)) |>
  filter(province %in% unique(Mafia$province))
#plot(st_geometry(italy_clean)) --> solo para validar que si cargue jeje
```

Descriptivas :)

```{r}
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)

# Tabla de estadísticas descriptivas
Mafia |>
  select(y, g, cd, cds1, cds2, u1, u2, mafiosi, murder) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    Mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
    Min  = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
    Max  = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
  ))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to  = c("Variable", ".value"),
               names_sep = "_") |>
  mutate(Description = c(
    "% growth of real per-capita value added",
    "Variation of per-capita public investment / lagged GDP",
    "Municipalities under external commissioners",
    "Same as cd (decree in first semester)",
    "Same as cd (avg days < 180)",
    "Change in log per-capita employment",
    "Change in log per-capita hours of unemployment insurance",
    "1st diff. of mafia-type association reports",
    "1st diff. of mafia-related murder reports"
  )) |>
  select(Variable, Description, Mean, SD, Min, Max) |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Descriptive Statistics")
```

Mapas

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Promediar variables por provincia
mafia_avg <- Mafia |>
  group_by(province) |>
  summarise(
    y        = mean(y,        na.rm = TRUE),
    g        = mean(g,        na.rm = TRUE),
    mafiosi  = mean(mafiosi,  na.rm = TRUE),
    murder   = mean(murder,   na.rm = TRUE),
    cds1    = sum(cds1,     na.rm = TRUE),
    cds2    = sum(cds2,     na.rm = TRUE) 
  )

# Join con shapefile
italy_mafia <- italy_clean |>
  left_join(mafia_avg, by = "province")

# mapa
mapa_italia <- function(variable, titulo, leyenda) {
  ggplot(italy_mafia) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = {{ variable }}), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = leyenda) +
    labs(title = titulo,
         caption = "Source: Mafia dataset (pder). Average 1986-1999.") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# Mapas individuales
mapa_y       <- mapa_italia(y,       "GDP per capita growth (y)",          "% growth")
mapa_g       <- mapa_italia(g,       "Public Spending variation (g)",      "variation")
mapa_mafiosi <- mapa_italia(mafiosi, "Mafia activity (mafiosi)",           "1st diff")
mapa_murder  <- mapa_italia(murder,  "Mafia-related murders",              "1st diff")
mapa_cds1    <- mapa_italia(cds1,    "Municipalities under commissioners (cds1)", "count")
mapa_cds2    <- mapa_italia(cds2,    "Municipalities under commissioners (cds2)", "count")

# Ver todos
mapa_y; mapa_g; mapa_mafiosi; mapa_murder; mapa_cds1; mapa_cds2
```

Matriz de pesos

```{r}
library(spdep)
library(sf)

# Centroides y matriz W por knn=4
coords   <- st_centroid(italy_clean) |> st_coordinates()
italy_nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 4))
italy_W  <- nb2listw(italy_nb, style = "W")
```

Test de Moran para autocorrelación espacial

```{r}
# Moran's I test para y y g
moran_y <- moran.test(italy_mafia$y, italy_W)
moran_g <- moran.test(italy_mafia$g, italy_W)

moran_y
moran_g
```

Scatter plot

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

moran_plot_gg <- function(var, W, titulo, color) {
  lag_var <- lag.listw(W, var)
  df <- data.frame(x = var, y = lag_var)
  
  # p-value del test de Moran
  mt <- moran.test(var, W)
  pval <- format(mt$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)
  moran_i <- round(mt$estimate[1], 3)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(color = color, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(var), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean(lag_var), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    labs(title = titulo,
         x = "Variable", y = "Spatially lagged variable",
         subtitle = paste0("Moran's I = ", moran_i, " | p-value = ", pval)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"))
}

# Generar plots
mp_y <- moran_plot_gg(italy_mafia$y, italy_W, 
                      "Moran Scatter Plot: GDP growth (y)", "steelblue")
mp_g <- moran_plot_gg(italy_mafia$g, italy_W, 
                      "Moran Scatter Plot: Public Spending (g)", "coral")

mp_y
mp_g
```
